task_description:
# Plugin System Architecture

Design and implement an extension/plugin system that allows community contributions. Support custom agents, validators, integrations, and UI components. Provide plugin SDK and documentation.

## Rationale
Enables ecosystem growth and community contributions. Addresses competitor pain point pain-6-1 (Devin closed source) by being extensible and transparent. Allows users to customize for their needs.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want to create a custom agent for my domain so that Turret handles specialized tasks
- As a community member, I want to share my plugins so that others can benefit

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Plugin SDK is documented and easy to use
- [ ] Plugins can add custom agents, validators, and UI panels
- [ ] Plugin security is enforced (sandboxing, permissions)
- [ ] Plugin marketplace or registry exists for discovery
- [ ] Official example plugins demonstrate capabilities
